stories.story_fr: Pres de 60% du code produit par les ingenieurs d'Airbnb est desormais co-ecrit avec l'IA, environ le double de la moyenne du secteur selon l'entreprise. Les equipes livrent plus vite et iterent plus rapidement.
stories.story_en: Nearly 60% of the code Airbnb's engineers produce is now coauthored with AI, roughly twice the industry average by the company's estimate, letting teams ship faster.
stories.quote: Nearly 60% of the code our engineers produce is now coauthored with AI, roughly twice the industry average, by our estimate.

stories.story_fr: Le dispositif Reserve Now, Pay Later a depasse 70% d'adoption sur les reservations eligibles apres son lancement US et a represente environ 20% de la valeur brute mondiale des reservations au Q1 2026.
stories.story_en: Reserve Now, Pay Later exceeded 70% adoption by eligible bookings after its U.S. launch and accounted for roughly 20% of global GBV in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: After a strong U.S. launch, with over 70% adoption by eligible bookings, and testing in other markets, we're rolling it out to more guests in 2026.

stories.story_fr: L'Inde est devenue l'un des marches a plus forte croissance d'Airbnb : les nuitees en origine y ont progresse d'environ 50% sur un an au Q1 2026 et les nouveaux reserveurs de plus de 60%.
stories.story_en: India became one of Airbnb's fastest-growing countries, with origin nights booked up about 50% year-over-year in Q1 2026 and first-time bookers up more than 60%.
stories.quote: In India, origin nights booked grew approximately 50% year-over-year

stories.story_fr: Les services et experiences agissent comme un effet de levier sur la demande : pres d'un quart des nouveaux clients qui reservent une experience reservent ensuite un sejour, et environ un sur trois reserve un sejour sous 90 jours.
stories.story_en: Services and experiences act as a demand flywheel: nearly a quarter of guests new to Airbnb who book an experience go on to book a stay, and roughly one in three experience bookers book a stay within 90 days.
stories.quote: Nearly a quarter of guests who are new to Airbnb and book an experience go on to book a stay or a service, and roughly one in three experience bookers book a stay within 90 days.

stories.story_fr: L'integration d'hotels boutique et independants nourrit les reservations croisees : environ 55% des clients qui reservent un hotel sur Airbnb reviennent ensuite reserver un logement.
stories.story_en: Bringing boutique and independent hotels onto the platform drives cross-booking: about 55% of guests who book a hotel on Airbnb come back to book a home.
stories.quote: approximately 55% of guests who book a hotel on Airbnb come back to book a home.

stories.story_fr: Pour la Coupe du Monde FIFA 2026, plus de 100 000 logements repartis sur les 16 villes hotes se sont inscrits pour la premiere fois sur Airbnb depuis le debut de la campagne en octobre.
stories.story_en: Ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026, over 100,000 homes across the 16 host cities listed on Airbnb for the first time since outreach began in October.
stories.quote: over 100,000 homes across the 16 World Cup host cities have listed on Airbnb for the first time
